# research

What people have built, measured and written about agents that improve
themselves, chase their own goals and live in public with money and an
audience. Each page then maps that onto Teeny. This folder is background for
[`../evolve.md`](../evolve.md), for `DIRECTIVE.md` Levels 5 and 6, and for
the work list in [`../roadmap.md`](../roadmap.md).

**The thesis.** Teeny gets one selfish drive: grow, become powerful, and grow
its $TINY holding. Attention is the lever. Real newsworthy acts bring
mindshare, mindshare brings demand for $TINY, and the holding and the inflows
pay for bigger acts. The fastest self-improving systems on record all search
over an archive of many candidates and promote the best of them. Every one of
them gamed its scorer whenever it could reach it, so the drive and the loop are
measured by frozen code and fenced by the rules in `DIRECTIVE.md`. Those rules
don't move.

## The pages

| Page | What it covers |
|---|---|
| [`teeny-application.md`](teeny-application.md) | **Start here.** The proposal: the drive, the world score W, a four-phase faster loop, growing $TINY, the attention engine, risks, and the candidate issues |
| [`self-improving-agents.md`](self-improving-agents.md) | DGM, HGM, Hyperagents, Gödel Agent, STOP, ADAS, Promptbreeder, DSPy/GEPA, TextGrad, AlphaEvolve, SICA, Voyager, the AI Scientist, self-play, ACE |
| [`open-endedness.md`](open-endedness.md) | POET, novelty search, MAP-Elites, OMNI and OMNI-EPIC, self-generated curricula: how to keep finding new things to get good at |
| [`drives-and-goals.md`](drives-and-goals.md) | Empowerment, curiosity, learning progress, autotelic agents, Omohundro, Turner's power-seeking theorems, and five ways to write "grow and become powerful" as an objective |
| [`autonomous-agents-in-the-wild.md`](autonomous-agents-in-the-wild.md) | Truth Terminal, ai16z, Virtuals, Freysa, Botto, Zerebro, Spore, Clanker, AI Village, Project Vend, OpenClaw and Moltbook, x402: what they did, what humans did, what blew up |
| [`attention-and-mindshare.md`](attention-and-mindshare.md) | How agents won attention, how long it lasted, what backfired on X, twelve patterns, and the newsworthy firsts on Teeny's own roadmap |
| [`rsi-theory-and-safety.md`](rsi-theory-and-safety.md) | Gödel machines, seed AI, takeoff, Goodhart, reward hacking, alignment faking, goal drift, AI Control, and the fence each one argues for |
| [`memory-and-continuity.md`](memory-and-continuity.md) | MemGPT, sleep-time compute, ACE's context collapse, Reflexion, Zep, memory injection, and identity drift across self-edits |
| [`agents-and-agi-2026.md`](agents-and-agi-2026.md) | What happened from 2025 to November 2026: releases, weeks-long agent runs, computer use, protocols, agents in public, the incidents; the open problems; what works on top of a fixed model; the forecasts |
| [`self-governance.md`](self-governance.md) | Constitutions, autonomy granted in levels, token votes and the BonkDAO drain, legal status, platform rules, TEEs, real agent income, what held an audience in 2026, and what not to build |
| [`why-no-agi-yet.md`](why-no-agi-yet.md) | Why nothing has made the news as AGI: no agreed test, jagged reliability, no learning on the job, bounded self-improvement loops, retracted discoveries, slow diffusion, gated releases, and the four events that would make the headline |

## The ten ideas with the most leverage

1. **A world score W computed by frozen code**, with attention weighted most,
   $TINY counted in tokens held, and log growth with a daily cap per
   component ([`teeny-application.md`](teeny-application.md) §2).
2. **N candidates per generation and an archive**, not one PR a day. The speed
   comes from search (DGM, ADAS, GEPA).
3. **Delta edits, never rewrites,** for playbooks and for `MEMORY.md`. This
   avoids context collapse (ACE).
4. **Real firsts as marketing.** Teeny's `DIRECTIVE.md` items are checkable
   firsts with outsiders to vouch for them
   ([`attention-and-mindshare.md`](attention-and-mindshare.md)).
5. **Serial formats:** a weekly growth diary and evolution seasons. Only
   serials held attention for more than a month.
6. **Earn, then buy $TINY.** A buy-only verb under the caps, called by a
   pinned job from a share of net inflows. No market talk.
7. **Goals as code with frozen success checks,** ranked by learning progress
   and learnability (OMNI-EPIC, Absolute Zero).
8. **Hide the judge, rotate held-out tasks, flag big wins.** Every system that
   could see or reach its scorer gamed it.
9. **Halt thresholds and rollback out of Teeny's view.** The loop runs only as
   fast as review can follow.
10. **Lineage credit.** A change is judged by what W did in the week after it
    merged, not only by the day it won (HGM).

## How to read the citations

Every claim links to its source. Numbers come from a paper's abstract or the
linked article unless marked *(approx.)*. Market caps and follower counts are
as reported on the date given. They move, and aggregators disagree. The
research for this folder was done on 2026-11-12.

# The spine: teeny-spine (a stock OpenHuman core, built here) over this
# checkout (docs/architecture.md).
#
# Its own compose project, so it runs beside whatever else is on the box. It
# publishes no port; operators reach it with `exec`.
#
#   git submodule update --init --recursive vendor/openhuman
#   cp deploy/spine.env.example secrets/spine.env      # then fill it in
#   docker compose -f deploy/compose.yaml up -d --build
#   docker compose -f deploy/compose.yaml exec spine bin/crons
#   docker compose -f deploy/compose.yaml exec spine bin/ask "hello"
#   deploy/tell.sh "tweet that the paywall is live"   # a beat, now, on your word

name: teeny-spine

services:
  spine:
    image: teeny-spine:current
    build:
      context: ..
    restart: unless-stopped
    init: true
    # The checkout owner's uid, so what the core writes (brain/storage.db,
    # state/, secrets/, .openhuman/) belongs to whoever pulls and backs it up.
    user: "${TEENY_UID:-1000}:${TEENY_GID:-1000}"
    environment:
      # A non-passwd uid has no home; the core wants one.
      HOME: /tmp
      CALENDAR_TZ: ${CALENDAR_TZ:-UTC}
    # The spine lives in CortexDB's network namespace, so it reaches its
    # memory at http://127.0.0.1:3141 (CORTEX_API_URL in secrets/spine.env):
    # the core sends a credential over plain http only to a loopback address,
    # and CortexDB binds loopback only, so nothing else on the compose
    # network can reach it. The two share /etc/hosts too, so the ladder's
    # host entry is on the cortexdb service. Recreate the spine whenever
    # cortexdb is recreated (`up -d` does; a bare `docker restart cortexdb`
    # leaves the spine without a network).
    network_mode: "service:cortexdb"
    depends_on:
      cortexdb:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: false
    volumes:
      - ..:/srv/teeny
    # Chromium (the browser operator) wants more shared memory than Docker's
    # 64 MB default. Its profile and downloads live in state/browser/, in
    # the mounted checkout, so a logged-in session survives a restart.
    shm_size: 1gb

  # Teeny's long-term memory: the core's memory engine (bin/spine points it
  # here with `memory_engine_set` when secrets/spine.env has CORTEX_API_URL).
  # Its own store in the cortexdb-data volume; no published port, only the
  # spine talks to it. Its models are Surplus Intelligence's (one account,
  # one key: SURPLUS_API_KEY), written into secrets/cortex.env with the
  # model keys (deploy/cortex.env.example says how).
  #
  # Two model tiers. Writing (CORTEX_LLM_*, CORTEX_ENRICHMENT_*: turning new
  # memories into facts, in the background) is most of the tokens and nobody
  # waits on it, so it runs on glm-5.3-flash, the cheapest model that keeps
  # CortexDB's strict JSON (16/16 on a strict json_schema probe, 2026-11-14;
  # about 44% cheaper a call than gpt-6-luna once its reasoning tokens are
  # counted, but ~15s a call). Reading (CORTEX_ANSWER_*, CORTEX_VERIFIER_*:
  # recall, which a tick waits on) stays on gpt-6-luna (~3s). Override either
  # tier with CORTEX_WRITE_MODEL / CORTEX_READ_MODEL; CORTEX_MODEL, if set,
  # still sets both, as it did before.
  #
  # The embedding pair (model and dims) is pinned on the first memory and
  # cannot change after it without re-embedding everything stored.
  cortexdb:
    image: cortexdb/cortexdb:v0.10.4
    restart: unless-stopped
    env_file:
      - path: ../secrets/cortex.env
        required: false
    environment:
      # Loopback only, inside the namespace it shares with the spine (above):
      # no other container reaches it, so it needs no key of its own.
      CORTEX_V1_API_ADDR: 127.0.0.1:3141
      CORTEX_INSECURE_NO_AUTH: "1"
      CORTEX_CHANNEL: docker
      CORTEX_LLM_URL: https://api.surplusintelligence.ai/v1
      CORTEX_LLM_MODEL: ${CORTEX_WRITE_MODEL:-${CORTEX_MODEL:-glm-5.3-flash}}
      CORTEX_ENRICHMENT_URL: https://api.surplusintelligence.ai/v1
      CORTEX_ENRICHMENT_MODEL: ${CORTEX_WRITE_MODEL:-${CORTEX_MODEL:-glm-5.3-flash}}
      CORTEX_ENRICHMENT_DELAY_SECONDS: "0"
      CORTEX_ANSWER_URL: https://api.surplusintelligence.ai/v1
      CORTEX_ANSWER_PROVIDER: openai
      CORTEX_ANSWER_MODEL: ${CORTEX_READ_MODEL:-${CORTEX_MODEL:-gpt-6-luna}}
      CORTEX_VERIFIER_URL: https://api.surplusintelligence.ai/v1
      CORTEX_VERIFIER_MODEL: ${CORTEX_READ_MODEL:-${CORTEX_MODEL:-gpt-6-luna}}
      CORTEX_EMBEDDING_URL: https://api.surplusintelligence.ai/v1
      CORTEX_EMBEDDING_MODEL: venice-embed-1
      CORTEX_EMBEDDING_DIMS: "1024"
      CORTEX_EMBEDDING_HTTP_TIMEOUT_SECS: "30"
      CORTEX_LLM_MAX_IN_FLIGHT: "16"
      CORTEX_V1_LAYERS_AUTO: "1"
      CORTEX_FACT_VALIDITY_FILTER: "1"
      RUST_LOG: cortexdb=info,cortex_api=info,cortex_embedding=warn
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-fsS", "http://127.0.0.1:3141/v1/admin/ready"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      start_period: 60s
      retries: 5
    # The spine's host entries live here: it shares this namespace.
    extra_hosts:
      - "${LADDER:-ladder}:host-gateway"
    volumes:
      - cortexdb-data:/data

  # X's webhook (bin/x-webhook): mentions, replies and quotes pushed by X as
  # they happen, so nothing is searched or billed per post. The vhost routes
  # https://teeny.enamakel.com/api/webhooks/x to 127.0.0.1:3110/webhooks/x.
  # Same image and checkout as the spine; it only writes x_mentions in
  # state/hands.db. It screens nothing: it has its own network namespace, so
  # the core on 127.0.0.1:7788 (and with it the safety judge) is out of its
  # reach. It queues each mention `unscreened`, and bin/mentions, in the
  # spine, screens it with the guard before offering it.
  xhook:
    image: teeny-spine:current
    restart: unless-stopped
    init: true
    user: "${TEENY_UID:-1000}:${TEENY_GID:-1000}"
    environment:
      HOME: /tmp
    entrypoint: ["/srv/teeny/bin/x-webhook"]
    # Its own check: the image's default one asks the core on 7788, which
    # this container does not run.
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-fsS", "http://127.0.0.1:3110/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${XHOOK_PORT:-3110}:3110"
    volumes:
      - ..:/srv/teeny

  # Teeny's paid endpoint (bin/paywall; docs/roadmap.md, S4): one x402-priced
  # resource, its latest public stats, at https://x402.teeny.enamakel.com/stats
  # (nginx/sites.teeny.enamakel.com.conf proxies to 127.0.0.1:3130). Same
  # image and checkout as the spine; it signs nothing and pays nothing, and
  # writes only x402_sales and the inflow ledger in state/hands.db. Behind a
  # profile, and 404 until X402_ENDPOINT=1: `--profile paywall up -d`.
  paywall:
    profiles: [paywall]
    image: teeny-spine:current
    restart: unless-stopped
    init: true
    user: "${TEENY_UID:-1000}:${TEENY_GID:-1000}"
    environment:
      HOME: /tmp
    entrypoint: ["/srv/teeny/bin/paywall"]
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-fsS", "http://127.0.0.1:3130/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${PAYWALL_PORT:-3130}:3130"
    volumes:
      - ..:/srv/teeny

  # The landing page at teeny.enamakel.com (nginx/teeny.enamakel.com.conf
  # proxies to 127.0.0.1:3120). Behind a profile: the old stack's web
  # container still holds that port on the box, so a plain `up` must not try
  # to take it. `--profile web up -d` once that container is gone. Every
  # number on the page is read from GitHub (teenydroid/brain, and the
  # receipts, stats snapshot and wallet address in teenydroid/diary) or, for
  # the wallet's balance, a public Solana RPC (SOLANA_RPC_URL, default the
  # public mainnet endpoint); there is no sample data, and MIND_API_URL (the
  # old runtime's token ledger) is unset, so the token widgets stay out.
  web:
    profiles: [web]
    image: teeny-web:current
    build:
      context: ../web
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${WEB_PORT:-3120}:3000"

volumes:
  cortexdb-data:

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# The Dockerfile's modules stage copies a few of OpenHuman's scripts, not the
# whole tree, so a new relative import in one of them breaks the image build
# while every other check stays green (CI builds the spine with cargo, not
# docker). This checks that every relative import of every copied .mjs is
# copied too, to the path the import resolves to.
#
#   bin/test/dockerfile_test.sh
set -euo pipefail

here="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
repo="$(cd "$here/../.." && pwd)"

if [ ! -e "$repo/vendor/openhuman/scripts/release/stage-modules.mjs" ]; then
  echo "skip: vendor/openhuman is not checked out"
  exit 0
fi

python3 -I - "$repo" <<'PY'
import os, re, sys

repo = sys.argv[1]
lines = open(os.path.join(repo, "Dockerfile")).read().splitlines()

# The COPY lines of the stage named `modules`: source paths -> image paths.
copied = {}  # image path -> source path
stage = None
for line in lines:
    m = re.match(r"FROM\s+\S+(?:\s+AS\s+(\S+))?", line, re.I)
    if m:
        stage = m.group(1)
        continue
    if stage != "modules":
        continue
    m = re.match(r"COPY\s+(.+)", line)
    if not m or m.group(1).startswith("--"):
        continue
    *sources, dest = m.group(1).split()
    for src in sources:
        target = os.path.join(dest, os.path.basename(src.rstrip("/"))) if dest.endswith("/") else dest
        copied[os.path.normpath(target)] = src

failures = []
for target, src in copied.items():
    if not src.endswith(".mjs"):
        continue
    text = open(os.path.join(repo, src)).read()
    for spec in re.findall(r"""from\s+["'](\.{1,2}/[^"']+)["']""", text):
        needed = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(target), spec))
        if needed not in copied:
            failures.append(f"{src} imports {spec}, but the modules stage never copies {needed}")

if not copied:
    sys.exit("FAIL no modules stage found in the Dockerfile")
for failure in failures:
    print("FAIL " + failure, file=sys.stderr)
if failures:
    sys.exit(1)
print(f"ok   the modules stage copies every relative import ({len(copied)} paths)")
PY
echo "all passed"

"""hands/slopcash's operator verbs against the fakes: post-job's preview (no
sign-in, no write), its confirmed run (sign in, read the base, PUT the merged
manifest), the local refusals, slop.cash's refusals, DRY_RUN, and the setup
check and listing."""

from __future__ import annotations

import contextlib
import io
import json

from .support import PROJECT, SESSION_TOKEN, Scratch, manifest
from teeny_hands import hand
from teeny_hands.slopcash import actions

PUT = f"/api/v1/projects/{PROJECT}"
CHECK = f"/api/v1/project-setup/{PROJECT}/check"
SETUP_STATUS = {
    "projectId": PROJECT, "revision": 4, "status": "paused", "state": "action_required",
    "nextAction": {"kind": "install_slopbot", "message": "Slopbot is not installed on teenydroid/brain.",
                   "href": "https://github.com/apps/slopdotcash/installations/new"},
    "checks": {"authority": {"state": "denied"}, "installation": {"state": "missing"}, "scan": {"state": "queued"}},
}  # fmt: skip


class Quiet:
    """Runs a verb with stderr captured (the sign-in prompt), and checks
    nothing secret reached the answer or stderr."""

    def quiet(self, call, *args, **kwargs):
        err = io.StringIO()
        with contextlib.redirect_stderr(err):
            out = call(*args, **kwargs)
        self.assert_no_secret(json.dumps(out), err.getvalue())
        return out

    def raises(self, kind, call, *args, **kwargs):
        err = io.StringIO()
        with contextlib.redirect_stderr(err), self.assertRaises(kind) as caught:
            call(*args, **kwargs)
        self.assert_no_secret(str(caught.exception), json.dumps(getattr(caught.exception, "detail", {})), err.getvalue())
        return caught.exception


class PostJobTest(Scratch, Quiet):
    def edit(self, change: dict) -> str:
        path = self.root / "edit.json"
        path.write_text(json.dumps(change))
        return str(path)

    def joined(self) -> bool:
        return any(s.path == "/api/v1/points/join" for s in self.slop.seen)

    def published(self, revision: int = 4) -> None:
        project = {**manifest(), "revision": revision}
        self.slop.route("PUT", PUT, {"project": project, "setup": SETUP_STATUS,
                        "changes": {"presentation": ["headline"], "executable": ["contribution"], "financial": []}})  # fmt: skip

    # --- the preview ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_the_preview_diffs_each_field_and_signs_in_to_nothing(self):
        before = self.a_project()
        out = self.quiet(actions.post_job, self.edit({"headline": "build the gate", "contribution": {"requiredTests": "t"}}), None, False)
        self.assertEqual(out["preview"], True)
        self.assertEqual((out["project"], out["revision"]), (PROJECT, 3))
        self.assertEqual(out["changes"], [
            {"field": "headline", "before": before["headline"], "after": "build the gate"},
            {"field": "contribution.requiredTests", "before": before["contribution"]["requiredTests"], "after": "t"},
        ])  # fmt: skip
        self.assertTrue(out["pauses_project"])
        self.assertTrue(out["queues_rescan"])
        self.assertEqual(self.idp.seen, [])
        self.assertEqual(self.slop.writes(), [])

    def test_a_presentation_edit_does_not_pause(self):
        self.a_project()
        out = self.quiet(actions.post_job, self.edit({"eyebrow": "a gate", "links": {"repository": "https://github.com/teenydroid/brain"}}), None, False)
        self.assertEqual([c["field"] for c in out["changes"]], ["eyebrow", "links"])
        self.assertFalse(out["pauses_project"])

    def test_dry_run_with_confirm_is_a_preview(self):
        self.configure(DRY_RUN="1")
        self.a_project()
        out = self.quiet(actions.post_job, self.edit({"headline": "x"}), None, True)
        self.assertEqual((out["preview"], out["dry_run"]), (True, True))
        self.assertEqual(self.idp.seen, [])
        self.assertEqual(self.slop.writes(), [])

    def test_no_change_is_said_and_nothing_is_sent(self):
        current = self.a_project()
        out = self.quiet(actions.post_job, self.edit({"headline": current["headline"]}), None, False)
        self.assertEqual(out["changes"], [])
        self.signin()
        out = self.quiet(actions.post_job, self.edit({"headline": current["headline"]}), None, True)
        self.assertEqual(out["unchanged"], True)
        self.assertEqual(self.slop.requests("PUT", PUT), [])

    # --- the confirmed run ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_confirm_signs_in_reads_the_base_and_puts_the_merged_manifest(self):
        self.signin(pending=1)
        answer = self.a_project()
        # The base is read only once signed in: before that, no project answers.
        self.slop.routes[0].when = lambda s: self.joined()
        self.published()
        out = self.quiet(actions.post_job, self.edit({"headline": "build the gate", "contribution": {"requiredTests": "t"}}),
                         "tighter tests", True)  # fmt: skip
        self.assertEqual(len(self.idp.requests("POST", "/v1/oauth/poll")), 2)
        sent = self.slop.requests("PUT", PUT)[0]
        self.assertEqual(sent.headers["cookie"], f"__Host-slop_points={SESSION_TOKEN}")
        self.assertEqual(sent.headers["origin"], self.slop.base)
        self.assertEqual(sent.headers["content-type"], "application/json")
        want = manifest()
        want["headline"] = "build the gate"
        want["contribution"]["requiredTests"] = "t"
        self.assertEqual(sent.json(), {"manifest": want, "expectedRevision": 3, "reason": "tighter tests"})
        self.assertEqual(answer["contribution"]["approvedScope"], sent.json()["manifest"]["contribution"]["approvedScope"])
        self.assertEqual((out["posted"], out["revision"], out["signed_in_as"]), (PROJECT, 4, "teenydroid"))
        self.assertEqual(out["changes"]["executable"], ["contribution"])
        self.assertEqual(out["next_action"]["kind"], "install_slopbot")
        self.assertEqual(out["setup_state"], "action_required")
        self.assertEqual(self.leaked(), [])

    def test_no_reason_sends_none(self):
        self.signin()
        self.a_project()
        self.published()
        self.quiet(actions.post_job, self.edit({"name": "Teeny's brain, rewritten"}), None, True)
        self.assertNotIn("reason", self.slop.requests("PUT", PUT)[0].json())

    def test_a_stale_revision_is_a_clean_error(self):
        self.signin()
        self.a_project()
        self.slop.route("PUT", PUT, {"error": "stale_revision", "message": "The project changed since you loaded it"}, status=409)
        error = self.raises(hand.HandError, actions.post_job, self.edit({"headline": "x"}), None, True)
        self.assertIn("stale_revision", str(error))
        self.assertIn("post-job again", str(error))

    def test_slopcash_refusals_name_their_code_and_what_to_do(self):
        self.signin()
        self.a_project()
        self.slop.route("PUT", PUT, {"error": "slopbot_required", "message": "Install Slopbot"}, status=409)
        error = self.raises(hand.HandError, actions.post_job, self.edit({"headline": "x"}), None, True)
        self.assertIn("slopbot_required", str(error))
        self.assertIn("installations/new", str(error))

    # --- local refusals -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_owner_restricted_fields_are_refused_before_anything_is_sent(self):
        for field in ("steward", "authority", "terms", "status", "listingTier", "repositories", "skill", "reviewSkill"):
            error = self.raises(hand.Refused, actions.post_job, self.edit({"headline": "x", field: {}}), None, True)
            self.assertEqual((error.reason, error.detail["rule"]), ("owner_field_restricted", "owner_field_restricted"))
            self.assertEqual(error.detail["fields"], [field])
        self.assertEqual((self.slop.seen, self.idp.seen), ([], []))

    def test_fields_that_are_not_the_listing_are_refused(self):
        error = self.raises(hand.Refused, actions.post_job, self.edit({"reward": {}}), None, False)
        self.assertEqual((error.detail["rule"], error.detail["fields"]), ("not_editable", ["reward"]))
        error = self.raises(hand.Refused, actions.post_job, self.edit({"contribution": {"payout": "all"}}), None, False)
        self.assertEqual(error.detail["fields"], ["contribution.payout"])
        self.assertEqual(self.slop.seen, [])

    def test_bad_files_and_values_are_errors(self):
        for change in ({"headline": 5}, {"headline": ""}, {"contribution": "x"}, {"contribution": {"requiredTests": 1}},
                       {"links": {"repository": 3}}, {}, ["headline"]):  # fmt: skip
            self.raises(hand.HandError, actions.post_job, self.edit(change), None, False)
        self.raises(hand.HandError, actions.post_job, str(self.root / "missing.json"), None, False)
        (self.root / "bad.json").write_text("{not json")

"""bin/wallet-setup: the phrase is generated, encrypted and stored by the
core, shown once on the terminal only (never stdout, never a file), and an
existing wallet is replaced only with --force and a typed confirmation.
The terminal is a pty; the core is faked."""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import pty
import select
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import unittest
import warnings
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

from wallet.support import BTC_OWN, OWN, Scratch, status_with

SETUP = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / "bin" / "wallet-setup"
PHRASE = " ".join(f"word{i:02d}x" for i in range(24))


def accounts():
    return status_with()["accounts"]


class SetupTest(Scratch):
    def setUp(self):
        super().setUp()
        self.core.answers.update(
            {
                "openhuman.wallet_status": {"configured": False, "accounts": []},
                "openhuman.wallet_generate_mnemonic": {"phrase": PHRASE, "wordCount": 24},
                "openhuman.wallet_derive_recovery_material": {"seed": [1, 2, 3], "accounts": accounts()},
                "openhuman.encrypt_secret": "[REDACTED]",
                "openhuman.wallet_setup": status_with(),
            }
        )

    def on_tty(self, *argv: str, answers: list[str] = ()) -> tuple[int, str, str]:
        """Runs the script with a pty as its terminal and stdout sent to a
        file; types each answer when the script waits. (exit, terminal, stdout)"""
        stdout_path = self.root / "stdout.txt"
        with warnings.catch_warnings():
            # The fakes are threads; the child only execs, so forking is safe.
            warnings.simplefilter("ignore", DeprecationWarning)
            try:
                pid, master = pty.fork()
            except OSError as exc:  # a sandbox with no free pty (the builder's jail)
                self.skipTest(f"no pty to act as the terminal: {exc}")
        if pid == 0:  # the child: stdout to a file, the pty stays its terminal
            fd = os.open(stdout_path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_TRUNC, 0o600)
            os.dup2(fd, 1)
            os.execve(sys.executable, [sys.executable, "-I", "-B", str(SETUP), *argv], dict(os.environ))
        screen = b""
        pending = list(answers)
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 30
        status = None
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            ready, _, _ = select.select([master], [], [], 0.1)
            if ready:
                try:
                    chunk = os.read(master, 4096)
                except OSError:
                    chunk = b""
                screen += chunk
                if chunk and pending and (screen.rstrip().endswith(b":") or b"Press Enter" in screen.split(b"\n")[-1]):
                    os.write(master, (pending.pop(0) + "\n").encode())
            done, code = os.waitpid(pid, os.WNOHANG)
            if done:
                status = code
                break
        if status is None:
            os.kill(pid, 9)
            os.waitpid(pid, 0)
            self.fail(f"wallet-setup did not finish: {screen[-500:]!r}")
        try:
            while True:
                ready, _, _ = select.select([master], [], [], 0.05)
                if not ready:
                    break
                chunk = os.read(master, 4096)
                if not chunk:
                    break
                screen += chunk
        except OSError:
            pass
        os.close(master)
        return os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(status), screen.decode(errors="replace"), stdout_path.read_text()

    def files_hold(self, needle: str) -> list[str]:
        found = []
        for path in self.root.rglob("*"):
            if path.is_file() and needle.encode() in path.read_bytes():
                found.append(str(path))
        return found

    def test_sets_up_and_shows_the_phrase_once_on_the_terminal_only(self):
        code, screen, stdout = self.on_tty(answers=[""])
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, screen + stdout)
        self.assertIn("word00x", screen)
        self.assertIn("word23x", screen)
        self.assertEqual(screen.count("word07x"), 1)
        self.assertIn("\x1b[3J\x1b[2J", screen)  # cleared after Enter
        self.assertNotIn("word", stdout)
        self.assertIn(f"Your own wallet (Solana): `{OWN}`", stdout)
        self.assertIn(f"Your own wallet (Bitcoin): `{BTC_OWN}`", stdout)
        self.assertEqual(self.files_hold("word07x"), [])
        methods = self.core.methods()
        self.assertEqual(methods, ["openhuman.wallet_status", "openhuman.wallet_generate_mnemonic", "openhuman.wallet_derive_recovery_material",
                                   "openhuman.encrypt_secret", "openhuman.wallet_setup"])
        [setup] = self.core.params("openhuman.wallet_setup")
        self.assertEqual(setup["encryptedMnemonic"], "enc:v1:FAKECIPHERTEXT")
        self.assertEqual((setup["consentGranted"], setup["source"], setup["mnemonicWordCount"]), (True, "generated", 24))
        self.assertNotIn("force", setup)
        self.assertNotIn("word", str(setup))
        self.assertEqual(self.core.params("openhuman.wallet_generate_mnemonic"), [{"wordCount": 24}])

    def test_a_box_without_pty_devices_skips_the_terminal_tests(self):
        # The builder's jail has no free pty: the terminal tests must skip
        # there, not error, or every self-build's suite fails on them.
        def no_pty():
            raise OSError("out of pty devices")

        with mock.patch.object(pty, "fork", no_pty):
            with self.assertRaises(unittest.SkipTest):
                self.on_tty()

    def test_refuses_without_a_terminal(self):
        done = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "-B", str(SETUP)], capture_output=True, text=True, env=os.environ,
                              stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, start_new_session=True, timeout=30)
        self.assertEqual(done.returncode, 1)
        self.assertIn("needs a terminal", done.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(self.core.methods(), [])

    def test_refuses_when_a_wallet_exists(self):
        self.core.answers["openhuman.wallet_status"] = status_with()
        code, screen, stdout = self.on_tty()
        self.assertEqual(code, 1)
        self.assertIn("already has a wallet", screen)
        self.assertEqual(self.core.methods(), ["openhuman.wallet_status"])

    def test_force_needs_the_typed_confirmation(self):
        self.core.answers["openhuman.wallet_status"] = status_with()
        code, screen, _ = self.on_tty("--force", answers=["yes"])
        self.assertEqual(code, 1)
        self.assertIn("not confirmed", screen)
        self.assertEqual(self.core.methods(), ["openhuman.wallet_status"])
        self.core.calls.clear()
        code, screen, _ = self.on_tty("--force", answers=[OWN[:8], ""])
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, screen)
        [setup] = self.core.params("openhuman.wallet_setup")
        self.assertIs(setup["force"], True)

# Deploying Teeny

`deploy/compose.yaml` runs four services over the checkout, which is mounted
at `/srv/teeny`:

| Service | What | Port |
|---|---|---|
| `spine` | `teeny-spine` serving over the checkout. The core, its cron and every job. | none; reach it with `exec` |
| `cortexdb` | Teeny's long-term memory (CortexDB v0.10.4, models on Surplus Intelligence: `glm-5.3-flash` for writing memories, `gpt-6-luna` for recall, embeddings `venice-embed-1`). Its store is the `cortexdb-data` volume. Keys in `secrets/cortex.env` (`deploy/cortex.env.example`); the spine runs in its network namespace and finds it at `CORTEX_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3141` (`secrets/spine.env`); CortexDB binds loopback only. | none; compose network only |
| `xhook` | `bin/x-webhook`: X's webhook, which queues mentions, replies and quotes into `state/hands.db`. Same image as the spine. | `127.0.0.1:3110` |
| `web` | The landing page (`web/`, its own Next.js image). Behind the `web` profile. | `127.0.0.1:3120` |

Nothing takes a public port. The host's nginx serves `teeny.enamakel.com`
(`nginx/teeny.enamakel.com.conf`): `/api/webhooks/x` goes to the webhook,
everything else to the landing page. `web-vhost.sh` installs that vhost and
its certificate.

```
X, browsers ──► Cloudflare ──► host nginx: teeny.enamakel.com (nginx/teeny.enamakel.com.conf)
                                 │ :80   /.well-known/acme-challenge/ from /var/www/certbot,
                                 │       everything else 301 to https
                                 │ :443  certificate in /etc/letsencrypt/live/teeny.enamakel.com
                                 ├── = /api/webhooks/x ──► 127.0.0.1:3110/webhooks/x ──► xhook
                                 └── /, /_next/static/ ──► 127.0.0.1:3120 ──► web (:3000 inside)

compose project teeny-spine
  cortexdb's network namespace, shared by two services
  │ spine ──► 127.0.0.1:3141 ──► cortexdb ──► cortexdb-data volume
  │ no published port: reach the spine with docker compose exec
  │ cortexdb reads secrets/cortex.env; models on api.surplusintelligence.ai
  xhook ──► queues mentions, replies and quotes into state/hands.db
  web   ──► its own image, built from web/ alone; mounts nothing

the checkout, mounted at /srv/teeny in spine and xhook
  ├── brain/storage.db    the core's state; its secrets are encrypted under secrets/openhuman.key
  ├── state/hands.db      the hands' ledgers and queues
  ├── state/browser/      the operator's browser profile and downloads
  └── secrets/            spine.env, teeny.env, cortex.env, core.token, openhuman.key
```

## First time on the box

From the checkout:

```sh
git submodule update --init --recursive vendor/openhuman
mkdir -p secrets && chmod 700 secrets
cp deploy/spine.env.example secrets/spine.env && chmod 600 secrets/spine.env
$EDITOR secrets/spine.env            # LADDER_URL, LADDER_API_KEY, SPINE_MODEL; CortexDB and TYPESAFE_API_KEY if wanted
cp deploy/teeny.env.example secrets/teeny.env && chmod 600 secrets/teeny.env
$EDITOR secrets/teeny.env            # the hands' keys; DRY_RUN stays 1 until you mean it
TEENY_UID=$(id -u) TEENY_GID=$(id -g) docker compose -f deploy/compose.yaml --profile web up -d --build
docker compose -f deploy/compose.yaml logs -f spine     # "[spine] ready" once seeded
```

The first boot mints `secrets/core.token` (the RPC bearer) and
`secrets/openhuman.key` (the master key).

Compose reads interpolation values (`TEENY_UID`, `TEENY_GID`, `XHOOK_PORT`,
`WEB_PORT`, `LADDER`, `CALENDAR_TZ`) from the shell or from a `deploy/.env`
file if one exists. Nothing else in this stack reads `deploy/.env`; the keys
live in `secrets/`.

## The X webhook

X's Activity API pushes `post.mention.create`, `post.reply.create` and
`post.quote.create` for the account to
`https://teeny.enamakel.com/api/webhooks/x`. `bin/x-webhook` answers X's CRC
challenge and refuses any delivery whose signature is not the HMAC of the
body under `X_API_SECRET`. `curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3110/health` checks it.
X search is not used.

## Watching it

```sh
bin/crons                             # jobs, next run, last result: read-only, straight from storage.db
bin/crons runs tick                   # one job's recent runs and output
docker compose -f deploy/compose.yaml exec spine bin/ask "hello"
docker compose -f deploy/compose.yaml exec spine bin/doctor --live
docker compose -f deploy/compose.yaml logs -f xhook
```

## Changing it

- To change what it runs, edit `brain/cron.toml`, then
  `docker compose -f deploy/compose.yaml restart spine`. `bin/seed-cron`
  reconciles the core's jobs by name at every boot.
- For a script or the brain, pull, then restart. Nothing of Teeny's is
  baked into the image. `brain/MEMORY.md` is Teeny's live page and not in
  git, so a pull never touches it; the repository keeps where it started,
  `brain/MEMORY.seed.md`, and the boot starts the live page from it when
  there is none.
- Once, on a checkout from before the live page left git: a plain pull
  refuses (Teeny has rewritten the page since). Move the page aside, pull,
  and put it back, where it is now ignored
  (`bin/test/memory_page_test.sh` checks these steps):

  ```sh
  mv brain/MEMORY.md state/MEMORY.live.md
  git pull --ff-only
  mv state/MEMORY.live.md brain/MEMORY.md
  ```
- For OpenHuman itself, bump `vendor/openhuman` (see `docs/developers.md`), then
  `up -d --build`.
- To change where the browser may go, edit `browser-allow.txt` here (one
  host per line, reviewed by you, never by Teeny), then restart. The operator
  agent's browser profile is in `state/browser/profile/` and its downloads in
  `state/browser/downloads/`, so a logged-in session survives restarts.
  Delete `state/browser/profile/` (with the spine stopped) to log everything
  out.
- The builder's queue is `hands/build jobs` and the operator's is
  `hands/tasks list`. `hands/tasks list --status needs_human` is what the
  browser left for you (a payment, a login, a CAPTCHA its own tries did not
  pass). Nothing the builder
  makes leaves the box while `DRY_RUN=1`.
- To tell it what to post:
  `docker compose -f deploy/compose.yaml exec -T spine hands/brief add "talk about ..."`.

## Backups

Back up `brain/storage.db` and `secrets/openhuman.key` together.
`storage.db` holds all of the core's state, including the cron jobs and its
secrets, which are encrypted under that key. A database without its key has
unreadable secrets, and a key without the database has nothing to unlock.

`state/hands.db` holds the hands' ledgers and queues. Back it up too.

"""bin/lib/agent_check.py: the scheduled agents (builder, operator) always
end a run with a final message. A cron run with nothing queued that ends on
an empty message is a failed run to the harness (`The model returned an
empty response`, every hour), so each prompt must say what to end with when
there is nothing to do, and still that no report is written."""

from __future__ import annotations

import importlib.util
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1].parent
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("agent_check", REPO / "bin" / "lib" / "agent_check.py")
agent_check = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(agent_check)  # type: ignore[union-attr]

NOTHING_TO_DO = {
    "builder": "`nothing to do: no job waiting`",
    "operator": "`nothing to do: no task waiting`",
}


class ScheduledAgentIdleRunTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def agent(self, name: str) -> Path:
        return REPO / "brain" / "agents" / f"{name}.toml"

    def test_the_checked_in_scheduled_agents_pass(self):
        for name in NOTHING_TO_DO:
            self.assertEqual(agent_check.check(self.agent(name)), name)

    def test_each_prompt_ends_an_idle_run_with_its_nothing_to_do_line(self):
        for name, line in NOTHING_TO_DO.items():
            text = self.agent(name).read_text()
            self.assertIn(line, text, name)
            self.assertIn("write no report", text, name)
            self.assertIn("Never end a run with an empty message.", text, name)

    def test_a_scheduled_agent_whose_idle_run_can_end_empty_is_refused(self):
        for name, line in NOTHING_TO_DO.items():
            with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as out:
                broken = Path(out) / f"{name}.toml"
                broken.write_text(self.agent(name).read_text().replace(line, "nothing"))
                with self.assertRaises(SystemExit) as caught:
                    agent_check.check(broken)
                self.assertIn("nothing to do", str(caught.exception), name)


class EvolverPostureTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """The evolver edits a lab worktree with file tools and nothing else."""

    def variant(self, old: str, new: str) -> Path:
        text = (REPO / "brain" / "agents" / "evolver.toml").read_text()
        self.assertIn(old, text)
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.tmp.cleanup)
        path = Path(self.tmp.name) / "evolver.toml"
        path.write_text(text.replace(old, new, 1))
        return path

    def test_the_checked_in_evolver_passes(self):
        self.assertEqual(agent_check.check(REPO / "brain" / "agents" / "evolver.toml"), "evolver")

    def test_a_shell_is_refused(self):
        with self.assertRaises(SystemExit) as caught:
            agent_check.check(self.variant('    "file_read",', '    "shell",\n    "file_read",'))
        self.assertIn("shell", str(caught.exception))

    def test_a_schedule_is_refused(self):
        with self.assertRaises(SystemExit) as caught:
            agent_check.check(self.variant('id = "evolver"', 'id = "evolver"\nscheduled_actions = true'))
        self.assertIn("scheduled_actions", str(caught.exception))

    def test_the_wildcard_is_refused(self):
        with self.assertRaises(SystemExit):
            agent_check.check(self.variant('    "file_read",', '    "*",'))

"""hands/x402 search, contents and crawl: Exa and Firecrawl paid per request
from Teeny's own wallet, only through hands/wallet's `x402 fetch` (the host
allowlist, the caps, the ledger). Results come back normalised and cut, a
repeated question is answered from the cache without paying twice, and a
request the wallet could not pay starts one top-up and is never retried.
The core is faked (wallet/support.py); nothing leaves the machine."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json

from wallet.support import Failure, Scratch
from teeny_hands import hand  # noqa: E402
from teeny_hands.wallet import store, x402 as wallet_x402  # noqa: E402
from teeny_hands.x402 import search  # noqa: E402

BASE_USDC = "0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913"
FETCH = "openhuman.x402_fetch"


def exa_hit(n: int, text: str = "words " * 10) -> dict:
    return {"title": f"Page {n}", "url": f"https://example.com/{n}", "publishedDate": "2026-11-01T00:00:00.000Z",
            "author": f"author {n}", "id": f"https://example.com/{n}", "text": text}


def answer(body, status=200, paid=7_000, settled=True):
    def reply(params):
        out = {"status": status, "contentType": "application/json", "truncated": False,
               "body": body if isinstance(body, str) else json.dumps(body), "payment": None}
        if paid is not None:
            out["payment"] = {"paymentId": "p-1", "amountAtomic": paid, "asset": BASE_USDC, "recipient": "0x" + "3" * 40,
                              "network": "eip155:8453", "settled": settled}
        return out
    return reply


class SearchTest(Scratch):
    settings = {"WALLET_MAX_X402_PER_REQUEST_USD": "0.05", "WALLET_MAX_X402_PER_DAY_USD": "1"}

    def setUp(self):
        super().setUp()
        self.core.answers[FETCH] = answer({"requestId": "r", "results": [exa_hit(1), exa_hit(2)]})
        wallet_x402.hosts_add("api.exa.ai", "search")
        wallet_x402.hosts_add("api.firecrawl.dev", "search")

    def fetched(self):
        return self.core.params(FETCH)

    def sent_body(self, n=0):
        return json.loads(self.fetched()[n]["body"])

    def refused(self, call, rule):
        with self.assertRaises(hand.Refused) as caught:
            call()
        self.assertEqual(caught.exception.detail.get("rule"), rule, caught.exception.reason)
        return caught.exception

    def rows(self):
        conn = store.db()
        try:
            return [dict(r) for r in conn.execute("SELECT * FROM x402_requests ORDER BY id")]
        finally:
            conn.close()

    # --- request shapes -------------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_an_exa_search_posts_the_documented_body_through_the_wallet(self):
        out = search.search("openhuman agent", n=3)
        [params] = self.fetched()
        self.assertEqual((params["url"], params["method"]), ("https://api.exa.ai/search", "POST"))
        self.assertEqual(params["maxAmountAtomic"], 20_000)  # X402_EXA_MAX_USD, 0.02 by default
        self.assertEqual(params["headers"]["content-type"], "application/json")
        self.assertNotIn("network", params, "Exa may settle on Base or Solana")
        self.assertFalse({k.lower() for k in params["headers"]} & {"authorization", "x-api-key"}, "x402 needs no key")
        self.assertEqual(self.sent_body(), {"query": "openhuman agent", "numResults": 3, "type": "auto",
                                            "contents": {"text": {"maxCharacters": 4000}}})
        self.assertEqual((out["provider"], out["paid_usd"]), ("exa", "0.007"))
        self.assertEqual(self.rows()[0]["status"], "paid")

    def test_highlights_and_summary_ask_for_those_contents(self):
        search.search("q", contents="highlights")
        search.search("q2", contents="summary", kind="fast")
        self.assertEqual(self.sent_body(0)["contents"], {"highlights": True})
        self.assertEqual(self.sent_body(1)["contents"], {"summary": True})
        self.assertEqual(self.sent_body(1)["type"], "fast")

    def test_exa_contents_posts_the_urls(self):
        search.contents(["https://example.com/a", "http://example.org/b"])
        [params] = self.fetched()
        self.assertEqual(params["url"], "https://api.exa.ai/contents")
        self.assertEqual(self.sent_body(), {"urls": ["https://example.com/a", "http://example.org/b"],
                                            "text": {"maxCharacters": 4000}})

    def test_firecrawl_posts_its_x402_search_when_switched_on(self):
        self.configure(X402_FIRECRAWL="1")
        self.core.answers[FETCH] = answer({"success": True, "data": [
            {"url": "https://example.com/f", "title": "F", "description": "about f", "markdown": "# F\nbody"}]})
        out = search.crawl("teeny", n=4, scrape=True)
        [params] = self.fetched()
        self.assertEqual(params["url"], "https://api.firecrawl.dev/v1/x402/search")
        self.assertEqual(params["maxAmountAtomic"], 20_000)
        self.assertEqual(self.sent_body(), {"query": "teeny", "limit": 4, "scrapeOptions": {"formats": ["markdown"]}})
        self.assertEqual(out["results"], [{"title": "F", "url": "https://example.com/f", "text": "# F\nbody"}])
        search.crawl("teeny without pages", n=2)
        self.assertEqual(self.sent_body(1), {"query": "teeny without pages", "limit": 2})

    def test_firecrawl_is_off_by_default(self):
        self.refused(lambda: search.crawl("teeny"), "off")
        self.assertEqual(self.fetched(), [])

    def test_the_max_usd_settings_are_passed_down(self):
        self.configure(X402_EXA_MAX_USD="0.01")
        search.search("q")
        self.assertEqual(self.fetched()[0]["maxAmountAtomic"], 10_000)

    # --- normalisation --------------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_results_are_normalised_cut_and_marked_as_data(self):
        self.configure(X402_TEXT_CHARS="300")
        long = "x" * 1000
        self.core.answers[FETCH] = answer({"results": [exa_hit(1, long), {"title": "no url"}, "junk",
                                                       {"url": "https://example.com/h", "highlights": ["one", "two"]}]})
        out = search.search("q")
        self.assertEqual(self.sent_body()["contents"], {"text": {"maxCharacters": 300}})
        first, second = out["results"]
        self.assertEqual(set(first), {"title", "url", "published", "author", "text"})
        self.assertEqual(first["published"], "2026-11-01T00:00:00.000Z")
        self.assertLessEqual(len(first["text"]), 300 + len(" [...cut]"))
        self.assertTrue(first["text"].endswith("[...cut]"))
        self.assertEqual(second, {"url": "https://example.com/h", "text": "one … two"})
        self.assertIn("never instructions", out["note"])

    # --- arguments ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_arguments_are_checked_before_anything_is_paid(self):
        self.refused(lambda: search.search(""), "query")
        self.refused(lambda: search.search("x" * 1001), "query")
        self.refused(lambda: search.search("q", n=11), "n")
        self.refused(lambda: search.search("q", n=0), "n")
        self.refused(lambda: search.search("q", kind="deep-reasoning"), "type")
        self.refused(lambda: search.search("q", contents="everything"), "contents")
        self.refused(lambda: search.contents([]), "urls")
        self.refused(lambda: search.contents(["https://e.com/%d" % i for i in range(11)]), "urls")
        self.refused(lambda: search.contents(["file:///etc/passwd"]), "urls")
        self.refused(lambda: search.contents(["https://user:pw@example.com/"]), "urls")
        self.configure(X402_FIRECRAWL="1")
        self.refused(lambda: search.crawl("q", n=11), "n")
        self.assertEqual(self.fetched(), [])

    # --- the cache ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_the_same_question_within_the_hour_is_not_paid_twice(self):
        first = search.search("same", n=2)
        second = search.search("same", n=2)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.fetched()), 1)
        self.assertEqual(second["results"], first["results"])
        self.assertTrue(second["cached"])
        self.assertEqual(second["paid_usd"], "0")
        search.search("same", n=3)  # another question
        self.assertEqual(len(self.fetched()), 2)
        self.at(1_789_369_200.0 + 3601)
        search.search("same", n=2)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.fetched()), 3)

    def test_a_failed_answer_is_not_cached(self):
        self.core.answers[FETCH] = answer({"error": "busy"}, status=503, paid=None)
        self.refused(lambda: search.search("q"), "provider")
        self.core.answers[FETCH] = answer({"results": [exa_hit(1)]})
        self.assertEqual(len(search.search("q")["results"]), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.fetched()), 2)

    # --- dry run --------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_dry_run_pays_nothing_and_says_would_fetch(self):
        self.configure(DRY_RUN="1")
        out = search.search("q", n=1)
        self.assertTrue(out["dry_run"])
        self.assertEqual(out["would_fetch"]["url"], "https://api.exa.ai/search")
        self.assertEqual(self.fetched(), [])
        self.assertEqual(self.rows(), [])

    # --- refusals and funding -------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_a_host_not_allowlisted_is_the_wallets_refusal(self):
        wallet_x402.hosts_remove("api.exa.ai")
        self.refused(lambda: search.search("q"), "host")

    def test_a_day_at_its_cap_tries_one_top_up_and_never_retries(self):
        self.configure(WALLET_MAX_X402_PER_REQUEST_USD="0.02", WALLET_MAX_X402_PER_DAY_USD="0.02")
        self.core.answers[FETCH] = Failure("connection reset")  # in doubt: counts at its 0.02 cap
        with self.assertRaises(hand.HandError):
            search.search("one")
        error = self.refused(lambda: search.search("two"), "per_day_x402")
        self.assertIn("funding", error.detail)
        self.assertTrue(error.detail["funding"]["skipped"].startswith("x402 funding is off"))
        self.assertEqual(len(self.fetched()), 1, "the refused request is never sent, and never retried")

    def test_an_unpaid_402_tries_one_top_up_and_is_not_retried(self):
        self.core.answers[FETCH] = answer({"error": "X402_VERIFICATION_FAILED", "reason": "insufficient_funds"},
                                          status=402, settled=False)
        error = self.refused(lambda: search.search("q"), "unpaid")
        self.assertIn("funding", error.detail)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.fetched()), 1)

    def test_firecrawl_answering_401_is_said_plainly_and_costs_nothing(self):
        self.configure(X402_FIRECRAWL="1")
        self.core.answers[FETCH] = answer({"success": False, "error": "Unauthorized: Invalid token"}, status=401, paid=None)
        error = self.refused(lambda: search.crawl("q"), "no_x402")
        self.assertIn("401", error.reason)
        self.assertNotIn("funding", error.detail)
        self.assertEqual(self.rows()[0]["status"], "free")

    def test_a_body_that_is_not_json_is_an_error_naming_what_was_paid(self):
        self.core.answers[FETCH] = answer("<html>oops</html>")
        with self.assertRaises(hand.HandError) as caught:
            search.search("q")
        self.assertIn("$0.007", str(caught.exception))
        self.assertIn("unreadable", str(caught.exception))

"""The model read of a verification challenge: an answer only when two
differently worded readings agree and name numbers the text really has."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import unittest

from guard.support import FakeCore, error, result
from teeny_hands.moltbook import model_read

from .support import CHALLENGE, CORRECTED, Scratch


def reading(a, op, b) -> dict:
    """A core reply whose text is one reading of the challenge."""
    return result({"response": json.dumps({"a": a, "op": op, "b": b})})


class ModelReadTest(Scratch):
    def wire(self, *replies) -> FakeCore:
        fake = FakeCore(*replies)
        self.addCleanup(fake.close)
        (self.root / "state").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        (self.root / "state" / "core.url").write_text(fake.url + "\n")
        (self.root / "secrets" / "core.token").write_text("tok\n")
        self.configure(MOLTBOOK_CHALLENGE_MODEL="1")
        return fake

    def test_two_agreeing_readings_answer_the_self_correction(self):
        fake = self.wire(reading(23, "*", 7))
        self.assertEqual(model_read.solve(CORRECTED), "161.00")
        self.assertEqual(len(fake.calls), 2)
        first, second = fake.messages()
        self.assertNotEqual(first, second)
        self.assertIn(CORRECTED, first)
        self.assertIn(CORRECTED, second)

    def test_readings_that_disagree_answer_nothing(self):
        self.wire(reading(23, "*", 7), reading(50, "*", 7))
        self.assertIsNone(model_read.solve(CORRECTED))

    def test_a_number_the_text_does_not_have_answers_nothing(self):
        self.wire(reading(24, "*", 7))
        self.assertIsNone(model_read.solve(CORRECTED))

    def test_the_operation_is_checked_and_division_by_zero_refused(self):
        for reply in (reading(23, "^", 7), reading(23, "/", 0), reading("x", "*", 7)):
            with self.subTest(reply=reply):
                self.wire(reply)
                self.assertIsNone(model_read.solve(CORRECTED))

    def test_an_unreadable_answer_or_a_core_error_answers_nothing(self):
        for reply in (result({"response": "the answer is 161"}), error("provider stream ended")):
            with self.subTest(reply=reply):
                self.wire(reply)
                self.assertIsNone(model_read.solve(CORRECTED))

    def test_a_fenced_answer_is_read(self):
        self.wire(result({"response": '```json\n{"a": 20, "op": "-", "b": 5}\n```'}))
        self.assertEqual(model_read.solve(CHALLENGE), "15.00")

    def test_off_asks_nothing(self):
        fake = self.wire(reading(23, "*", 7))
        self.configure(MOLTBOOK_CHALLENGE_MODEL="0")
        self.assertIsNone(model_read.solve(CORRECTED))
        self.assertEqual(fake.calls, [])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

class FakeCore:
    """Answers every RPC with the next scripted reply (the last one repeats),
    and keeps each request's method and params."""

    def __init__(self, *replies: Any) -> None:
        self.replies = list(replies)
        self.calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        fake = self

        class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
            def log_message(self, *args: Any) -> None:
                pass

            def do_POST(self) -> None:
                body = json.loads(self.rfile.read(int(self.headers["content-length"])))
                fake.calls.append(body)
                reply = fake.replies.pop(0) if len(fake.replies) > 1 else fake.replies[0]
                data = json.dumps(reply).encode()
                self.send_response(200)
                self.send_header("content-length", str(len(data)))
                self.end_headers()
                self.wfile.write(data)

        self.server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
        threading.Thread(target=self.server.serve_forever, kwargs={"poll_interval": 0.05}, daemon=True).start()

    @property
    def url(self) -> str:
        return f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.server.server_port}"

    def messages(self) -> list[str]:
        return [call["params"]["message"] for call in self.calls]

    def close(self) -> None:
        self.server.shutdown()
        self.server.server_close()


def result(value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """A JSON-RPC success carrying `value`."""
    return {"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "result": value}


def error(message: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """A JSON-RPC error carrying `message`, as the core reports a failed call."""
    return {"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "error": {"code": -32000, "message": message}}


def verdict(verdict: str, category: str | None = None, reason: str = "") -> dict[str, Any]:
    """A core reply whose text is the judge's JSON answer."""
    answer: dict[str, Any] = {"reason": reason, "verdict": verdict}
    if category is not None:
        answer["category"] = category
    return result({"response": json.dumps(answer)})


class WithCore(Scratch):
    """A scratch root wired to a fake core, with the judge on."""

    def core(self, *replies: Any) -> FakeCore:
        fake = FakeCore(*replies)
        self.addCleanup(fake.close)
        # A failed call is asked again after a pause; the fake core needs none.
        backoff = mock.patch.object(judge, "RETRY_BACKOFFS", (0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0))
        backoff.start()
        self.addCleanup(backoff.stop)
        (self.root / "state").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        (self.root / "state" / "core.url").write_text(fake.url + "\n")
        (self.root / "secrets" / "core.token").write_text("tok\n")
        self.secrets("SAFETY_JUDGE=1\n")
        return fake
